title: SENIOR IMS-QEHS CONSULTANT
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**IMS–QEHS CONSULTANT**

**Position:**
IMS–QEHS Consultant

**Department:**
Consulting & Advisory Services

**Location:**
Hyderabad / Client Locations / PAN India

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time / Consultant / Contract

**Reporting To:**
Practice Head / Director – Consulting

**Travel:**
Willingness to travel to client locations as required

**1. POSITION PURPOSE**

The IMS–QEHS Consultant is responsible for
**planning, implementing, auditing, and improving Integrated Management Systems (IMS) covering Quality, Environment, Occupational Health & Safety and related QEHS requirements**
at client organizations.

The consultant will work closely with client management and functional teams to convert
**ISO requirements into practical, effective and sustainable business processes**
, rather than focusing only on documentation or certification.

The role requires strong consulting capability, client handling, audit skills, documentation skills and the ability to independently manage projects from
**kick-off through implementation, internal audit, management review and certification readiness**
.

**2. KEY STANDARDS / SYSTEMS**

The consultant should have working knowledge of relevant standards, particularly:

**Core IMS Standards**

* ISO 9001 – Quality Management System
* ISO 14001 – Environmental Management System
* ISO 45001 – Occupational Health & Safety Management System

**Additional Standards – Advantage**

* ISO 50001 – Energy Management
* ISO 27001 – Information Security
* ISO 22000 / HACCP – Food Safety
* ISO 13485 – Medical Devices
* IATF 16949 – Automotive
* ISO 17025 – Testing & Calibration Laboratories
* ISO 10002 – Customer Complaints
* ESG / Sustainability frameworks
* Applicable statutory and regulatory requirements

**3. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Project Planning & Client Kick-off**

* Understand client requirements, scope, industry and business processes.
* Participate in client kick-off meetings.
* Develop project implementation plans and timelines.
* Identify project deliverables, responsibilities and milestones.
* Prepare project charter / implementation plan where required.
* Coordinate with client process owners and management representatives.
* Ensure projects are delivered within agreed timelines and mandays.

**B. Gap Assessment**

* Conduct detailed gap assessments against applicable ISO standards.
* Review existing systems, processes, records and practices.
* Conduct interviews with process owners and employees.
* Identify compliance gaps, risks, weaknesses and improvement opportunities.
* Prepare professional gap assessment reports.
* Prioritize gaps based on business risk and implementation importance.
* Develop action plans with responsibilities and target dates.

**C. IMS Documentation Development**

Develop / review practical documentation including:

* IMS Manual
* Quality Policy
* Environmental Policy
* OH&S Policy
* Objectives and KPI framework
* Context of the organization
* Interested-party analysis
* Risk & Opportunity Registers
* Environmental Aspect & Impact Register
* Hazard Identification & Risk Assessment
* Legal & Other Requirements Register
* Operational procedures
* SOPs / Work Instructions
* Emergency Preparedness & Response procedures
* Quality control procedures
* Environmental management procedures
* OH&S procedures
* Forms, formats and records

**Key expectation:**
Documentation must reflect actual client operations and should not become unnecessary paperwork.

**D. Implementation & System Activation**

* Support clients in implementing documented systems.
* Conduct process-wise implementation meetings.
* Assist departments in developing operational controls.
* Establish measurable objectives and KPIs.
* Support implementation of risk-based thinking.
* Develop monitoring and measurement systems.
* Support legal and compliance evaluation.
* Establish operational controls for environmental and OH&S risks.
* Ensure adequate evidence and records are generated.
* Monitor implementation progress against project plan.

**E. Training & Awareness**

Conduct / facilitate training programs such as:

* ISO awareness training
* IMS awareness
* Quality management principles
* Environmental awareness
* OH&S awareness
* Risk & Opportunity Management
* Aspect & Impact Assessment
* HIRA / Risk Assessment
* Legal compliance awareness
* Internal Auditor Training
* Emergency preparedness
* Corrective Action / CAPA
* Root Cause Analysis
* Continual Improvement
* Process approach and KPI management

Training should be
**practical, interactive and relevant to the client's operations**
.

**4. INTERNAL AUDIT & AUDIT SUPPORT**

* Prepare internal audit plans and checklists.
* Conduct internal audits against applicable standards.
* Interview personnel and verify objective evidence.
* Identify nonconformities, observations and improvement opportunities.
* Prepare internal audit reports.
* Support root cause analysis and corrective action.
* Verify effectiveness of corrective actions.
* Prepare clients for Stage 1 / Stage 2 certification audits.
* Participate in certification audit support activities.
* Assist clients in responding to certification-body findings.

**5. MANAGEMENT REVIEW & CONTINUAL IMPROVEMENT**

Support clients in conducting effective Management Reviews covering:

* Quality objectives and KPI performance
* Customer satisfaction
* Audit results
* Nonconformities and CAPA
* Environmental performance
* OH&S performance
* Legal compliance
* Risks and opportunities
* Resource requirements
* Supplier / contractor performance
* Incident performance
* Improvement opportunities

Develop meaningful management-review inputs and action plans.

**6. CLIENT MANAGEMENT**

* Act as a professional consultant and trusted advisor to assigned clients.
* Maintain regular communication with client management.
* Conduct periodic project review meetings.
* Clearly communicate project progress, risks and delays.
* Handle client queries professionally.
* Maintain confidentiality of client information.
* Build long-term client relationships.
* Identify opportunities for additional Smartedge services where appropriate.

**7. PROJECT MANAGEMENT & DELIVERY**

The consultant will be responsible for:

* Completing assigned projects within agreed timelines.
* Managing allocated mandays effectively.
* Maintaining project schedules.
* Maintaining project documentation.
* Updating project trackers.
* Meeting agreed project milestones.
* Escalating delays and risks promptly.
* Ensuring client deliverables are completed correctly the first time.
* Maintaining high standards of consulting quality.

**Typical project delivery flow:**

**Client Kick-off → Gap Assessment → Implementation Planning → Training → Documentation → Implementation → Internal Audit → CAPA → Management Review → Certification Readiness → Certification Support → Project Closure**

**8. BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT SUPPORT**

The consultant is expected to contribute to business development by:

* Understanding client business challenges.
* Identifying potential improvement opportunities.
* Supporting technical proposal preparation.
* Providing inputs for scope and effort estimation.
* Participating in technical discussions with prospects.
* Supporting client presentations.
* Identifying cross-selling opportunities.
* Generating referrals from satisfied clients.

The consultant is
**not expected to function primarily as a salesperson**
, but should actively support technical business development.

**9. REPORTING & DOCUMENT CONTROL**

Maintain:

* Project tracker
* Daily / weekly activity report
* Client meeting minutes
* Gap assessment report
* Training records
* Audit reports
* CAPA tracker
* Project deliverable tracker
* Consultant timesheet / manday utilization
* Project closure report
* Client feedback

All project documents shall be maintained in accordance with Smartedge document-control and information-security requirements.

* B.Tech/M.Tech in Electrical Engineering or any relevant field with 2-6 years of experience in BESS design, commissioning, or technical asset management for utility-scale energy storage or solar + storage projects.

title: CGT Lead
description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
  
  
**Environmental Conditions**
Various outside weather conditions
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Drive the growth of Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Cell & Gene Therapy (CGT) business by enabling and leading integrated workflow selling across businesses.
  
  
The role will identify strategic CGT opportunities, understand customers’ scientific, process-development and manufacturing workflows, and bring together capabilities from across Thermo Fisher Scientific to create differentiated, end-to-end solutions.
  
  
A critical aspect of this role is the ability to
**influence without direct authority**
. The incumbent will work across multiple businesses, commercial teams, product specialists, application scientists, marketing, service and other functions to create alignment around customer opportunities and mobilize the right capabilities to win.
  
  
The role will act as a
**CGT workflow orchestrator**
, moving customer engagement beyond individual products toward integrated solutions spanning research, process development, clinical translation and commercial manufacturing.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**CGT Workflow Selling & Business Growth**

* Develop and execute the commercial strategy for growing Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Cell & Gene Therapy business across assigned markets and strategic customers.
* Identify and develop high-value opportunities where multiple Thermo Fisher businesses can participate in the customer workflow.
* Build a strong pipeline of integrated CGT workflow opportunities rather than relying primarily on individual product opportunities.
* Understand customer programs from early research and process development through clinical translation, scale-up and commercial manufacturing to identify opportunities across the workflow.
* Connect relevant capabilities across cell biology, cell culture, cell processing, gene editing, viral vector and plasmid workflows, bioprocessing, analytical technologies, instruments, consumables, reagents and services.
* Translate customer scientific and manufacturing challenges into integrated Thermo Fisher value propositions.
* Drive penetration and share of wallet within strategic CGT customers through broader workflow adoption.
* Maintain strong commercial discipline around pipeline development, opportunity progression, forecasting and execution.

**One Thermo Fisher – Cross-Business Leadership**

* Serve as the commercial integrator for CGT opportunities across Thermo Fisher Scientific businesses.
* Bring together Business Units, commercial teams, Technical Sales Specialists, Application Scientists, Product Management, Marketing, Service and other relevant stakeholders around priority CGT opportunities.
* Establish a clear opportunity strategy and define how different businesses can collectively address the customer’s workflow.
* Create alignment across businesses on customer priorities, value propositions, engagement strategy and execution.
* Ensure individual product discussions are connected wherever appropriate into a broader CGT workflow and customer strategy.
* Identify gaps or overlaps between businesses and facilitate decisions that enable a coordinated One Thermo Fisher approach.
* Act as the internal voice of the CGT customer, ensuring customer workflow requirements and emerging needs are understood across relevant businesses.

**Influence Without Authority**
Success in this role will depend heavily on the ability to
**lead through influence rather than organizational authority**
.
  
  
The incumbent will:
  
  

* Build credibility and trusted relationships with commercial and business leaders across Thermo Fisher Scientific.
* Influence Business Units and sales teams to collaborate on opportunities that span organizational boundaries.
* Create alignment among stakeholders who may have different priorities, objectives and reporting structures.
* Mobilize resources across businesses without necessarily having direct control over those resources.
* Establish shared objectives and mutual accountability around strategic CGT opportunities.
* Navigate a complex matrix organization and resolve competing priorities through collaboration, data, customer insight and business rationale.
* Build internal advocacy for CGT opportunities and secure commitment from relevant stakeholders.
* Facilitate decisions and maintain momentum across complex opportunities involving multiple internal and customer stakeholders.
* Demonstrate strong executive presence, stakeholder management, negotiation and influencing skills.

**Strategic Customer Leadership**

* Develop strong relationships with biotechnology, biopharmaceutical, CDMO, academic, translational research and other organizations participating in the Cell & Gene Therapy ecosystem.
* Engage senior scientists, R&D leaders, process-development teams, manufacturing leaders, procurement teams and business executives.
* Develop a deep understanding of customers’ therapeutic pipelines, technology platforms, manufacturing strategies, capacity expansion plans and long-term priorities.
* Build multi-year strategic account and workflow plans for priority CGT customers.
* Identify opportunities for broader strategic partnerships extending beyond individual product transactions.
* Lead complex, high-value opportunities involving multiple Thermo Fisher businesses and multiple customer stakeholders.
* Conduct strategic business reviews and workflow discussions with key customers.

**Scientific & Workflow Leadership**

* Develop strong understanding of evolving Cell & Gene Therapy technologies, modalities, manufacturing platforms and customer workflow challenges.
* Maintain working knowledge across cell therapy, gene therapy, gene editing, viral vectors, plasmids, regenerative medicine and other relevant advanced-therapy areas.
* Engage customers in scientifically credible, workflow-oriented discussions.
* Enable commercial teams to move from product selling to consultative, workflow-based and outcome-oriented selling.
* Translate scientific and technology developments into actionable commercial opportunities.
* Partner with Business Units, application teams, R&D and Product Management to communicate unmet customer needs and emerging workflow requirements.
* Support scientific forums, workshops, seminars, roundtables and customer innovation discussions that strengthen Thermo Fisher Scientific’s position within the CGT ecosystem.

**Commercial Enablement & Opportunity Leadership**

* Work alongside divisional and regional commercial teams to identify, qualify and progress strategic CGT opportunities.
* Coach and enable sales teams on CGT workflows, customer discovery, consultative selling and cross-business opportunity development.
* Support teams in mapping customer workflows, stakeholders, decision-making processes and competitive positions.
* Develop compelling integrated value propositions for complex customer opportunities.
* Facilitate opportunity strategy sessions involving relevant businesses and specialists.
* Establish mechanisms to track major cross-business CGT opportunities and ensure clear actions, ownership and follow-through.
* Review pipeline quality, customer engagement and competitive activity and drive corrective actions where required.

**Market Development & Strategic Insights**

* Continuously assess the CGT market, including scientific developments, therapeutic pipelines, manufacturing investments, technology shifts, funding trends and evolving customer needs.
* Identify emerging workflow opportunities and areas where Thermo Fisher Scientific can create differentiated value through its combined portfolio.
* Translate market and customer intelligence into recommendations for commercial strategy, portfolio development, marketing and customer engagement.
* Provide structured feedback to business and regional leadership regarding customer requirements, competitive threats and emerging opportunities.
* Identify opportunities for strategic collaborations and ecosystem partnerships where appropriate.

**Education & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Biomedical Engineering, Pharmacy, Cell Biology, Immunology or a related scientific discipline.
* Advanced scientific qualification such as a PhD is advantageous.
* MBA or equivalent business/commercial qualification is desirable but not mandatory.

**Experience**

* Typically 15+ years of progressive experience in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biopharma, Cell & Gene Therapy, Bioprocessing or related industries.
* Strong understanding of the Cell & Gene Therapy ecosystem and associated research, process-development, manufacturing and analytical workflows.
* Significant experience in commercial leadership, business development, strategic account management, technical sales or market development.
* Demonstrated experience selling or developing complex workflow solutions involving multiple technologies, product categories or business units.
* Proven experience managing complex, high-value, multi-stakeholder commercial opportunities.
* Demonstrated ability to engage senior scientific, technical, manufacturing, commercial, procurement and executive stakeholders.
* Experience operating successfully within a complex matrix organization where outcomes depend on influence rather than direct authority.
* Proven record of building alignment and driving execution across multiple businesses and functions.

**Key Competencies**
**Influence Without Authority**
Exceptional ability to create alignment, gain commitment and drive execution across teams and businesses that do not directly report to the role.
  
  
**Workflow & Solution Selling**
Ability to understand complex customer workflows and connect multiple Thermo Fisher capabilities into differentiated customer solutions.
  
  
**CGT Scientific & Commercial Acumen**
Strong understanding of Cell & Gene Therapy technologies, customer workflows, business drivers and market dynamics.
  
  
**Cross-Business Collaboration**
Ability to operate effectively across organizational boundaries and create a One Thermo Fisher approach to strategic opportunities.
  
  
**Strategic Customer Leadership**
Ability to understand customer strategy beyond individual product requirements and build long-term, multi-level relationships.
  
  
**Executive Communication & Stakeholder Management**
Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and influencing capabilities with both internal and external senior stakeholders.
  
  
**Commercial Execution**
Strong opportunity management, account planning, forecasting, prioritization and execution discipline.
  
  
**Learning Agility**
Ability to rapidly understand emerging CGT technologies and translate scientific developments into commercial opportunities.
  
  
**Key Measures of Success**
Success in this role will be measured through:
  
  

* Sustainable growth of the Cell & Gene Therapy business.
* Growth and quality of the cross-business CGT workflow opportunity pipeline.
* Revenue generated through integrated / multi-business CGT opportunities.
* Increased penetration and share of wallet within strategic CGT customers.
* Number and quality of customers adopting broader Thermo Fisher workflow solutions.
* Effectiveness of cross-business collaboration and One Thermo Fisher execution.
* Ability to mobilize internal stakeholders and resources through influence without direct authority.
* Development of strategic customer relationships and executive-level engagement.
* Forecast accuracy and disciplined progression of strategic opportunities.
* Ability to translate emerging CGT customer needs and market trends into actionable growth opportunities.

title: Co-Founder
description:
MDS Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an ambitious Co-Founder who is ready to embark on an exciting startup adventure and join us on an extraordinary journey of innovation, invention, and impact. If you want to help build technologies and products that can transform lives and shape the future of humanity, this is your opportunity to become a co-creator of MDS's grand vision: "Shaping the future through innovation and advanced technology, creating a powerful, intelligent, and human-centered world."

Co-Founder Investment

As a co-founder, we are looking for someone who is willing to invest in MDS as a demonstration of their commitment to the business, its vision, and its long-term success. The amount you choose to invest is entirely at your discretion. Your investment, together with your role, commitment, and contribution, will be reflected in your equity in the company.

About Us

Mahadeva Digital Solutions Private Limited (MDS) is a technology company based in Hyderabad, India. Founded on May 8, 2025, MDS is a Startup India-recognized company. Its primary goal is to build innovative products that create a positive impact on the world.

MDS is currently focused on developing innovative Human-Interactive AI and Affective AI technologies to ensure that AI better serves humanity by enhancing human capabilities, intelligence, and quality of life at scale, rather than becoming a threat to society.

As part of these initiatives, MDS is preparing to launch its flagship product, Noorva Companion MLP, under its broader Noorva Ecosystem vision of building humanized AI solutions around people's daily lives. Noorva Companion is a next-generation application designed to help individuals improve and enrich their everyday lives (additional details will be shared with selected candidates).

MDS has already established a strong team and solid startup foundation and is now looking to further strengthen its leadership by bringing on a committed Co-Founder, who will serve as a co-creator of the company's vision.

MDS is a strongly principle-centered and values-driven organization. Its core purpose is to create meaningful value for the world through its work, innovation, and commitment to human progress. To learn more about MDS, visit MDSIndia.in.

Who We're Looking For

We're not just looking for a co-founder. We're looking for someone who:

* Thinks big and isn't afraid to take bold bets.
* Takes ownership and turns ideas into reality.
* Is ambitious, driven, and passionate about creating meaningful impact.
* Wants to challenge the status quo and help shape the future.
* Sees technology as a force for positive change.
* Wants to build something extraordinary rather than simply work for it.
* Is ready to leave their mark on the world and create a better tomorrow for generations to come.

Responsibilities

Fundraising and Financial Management: You will be co-leading fundraising efforts, pitching to investors, preparing business cases, and managing capital requirements.

* You will monitor budgets, allocate resources responsibly, and ensure financial discipline to support growth and operational scalability.

Product and Operations Oversight: You will oversee product roadmaps, establish operational processes, and ensure alignment between development efforts and market demands.

* You will take on an executive role as COO and will be involved in day-to-day decision-making during the early stages.

Team Building and Leadership: Recruiting, mentoring, and developing a high-performing team is a key responsibility.

* You will assign roles, maintain morale, and foster a collaborative culture that encourages innovation and accountability.
* You will also ensure that each team member's responsibilities are clear and aligned with the company's goals.

Risk Management and Problem Solving: You will assess risks related to product, market, finances, and operations, and implement strategies to mitigate them.

* You will adapt to challenges, pivot when necessary, and make timely decisions based on data, expert input, and market feedback.

Brand Development and External Relations: You will represent the company to investors, partners, customers, and the media.

* You will help build credibility, establish strategic partnerships, and communicate the company's vision effectively to stakeholders.

Cross-Functional Leadership: Acting as a bridge between departments, as COO you will foster collaboration across teams, breaking down silos and ensuring smooth coordination.

* You will oversee multiple departments, including product development, project management, research and development, product design, and administrative functions, ensuring that resources are effectively utilized.

Strategic Partner to the CEO: While the CEO focuses on vision, external relationships, and long-term strategy, the COO translates these high-level plans into actionable initiatives.

* You may lead expansion projects, mergers, acquisitions, or new product rollouts, ensuring that strategic objectives are implemented efficiently.

Compliance and Governance: You will ensure adherence to statutory regulations, corporate policies, and industry standards.

* You may be accountable for labour laws, environmental regulations, taxation, and contractual obligations, coordinating with legal teams to manage operational risks.

Problem Solving and Innovation: You are expected to be a resourceful problem solver, continuously seeking ways to improve operational efficiency, implement innovative solutions, and maintain competitive advantage through operational excellence.

Qualifications

* Anyone can apply. Your educational background is not a deciding factor if you have the skills, mindset, and desire to be part of something big.
* A background in business, finance, entrepreneurship, or related experience will be considered an added advantage.
* MDS Pvt. Ltd. is an inclusive company, and we welcome applications from individuals of all genders, regions, races, nationalities, and economic backgrounds.
* Note: We are also looking for a candidate who is willing to invest in the company as a demonstration of their commitment to the business, its vision, and its long-term success. The amount you choose to invest is entirely at your discretion.
* This opportunity is not for someone who makes promises without following through. Greatness is not built on great words alone, but on consistent action, commitment, and execution.

Compensation

* The selected candidate will receive equity in the company, based on their role, commitment, experience, and overall value contribution to the business.
* Salary and other compensation details will be discussed with shortlisted candidates.

How to Apply

* Apply on our website: https://www.mdsindia.in/careers/co-founder
* We encourage you to write your cover letter in your own words. Tell us about your ideas, ambitions, and why you want to be part of MDS. We'd rather hear your authentic voice than read an AI-generated response.

title: Senior Safety Technology Analyst
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose -- moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart(R).
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Senior Safety Technology Analyst to join our team. As a Senior Safety Technology Analyst, you will drive the strategic implementation and operational excellence of Parexel's pharmacovigilance safety technology systems. This position plays a critical role in ensuring regulatory compliance, system optimization, and the delivery of advanced safety solutions that protect patient safety and accelerate clinical research. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams across Safety Operations, IT, Quality Assurance, and external auditors, following industry-standard processes and regulatory frameworks. Responsibilities include designing and implementing complex technology solutions, managing system integrations, leading change management initiatives, and providing expert guidance on safety database platforms and emerging pharmacovigilance technologies.
  
  
You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through advancing patient safety, driving operational excellence, and shaping the future of clinical research technology. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Safety Technology Administrator can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research technology, regulatory compliance, and strategic system implementation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the setup, configuration, and support of Parexel's safety database and associated systems, including new study implementations, periodic and ad-hoc report generation, expedited report rule configuration, and comprehensive end-user support
* Direct the planning and execution of safety database handovers from clients to Parexel and from Parexel to clients at project completion, ensuring seamless transitions for complex pharmacovigilance operations
* Design and deliver complex integration solutions between Parexel safety technologies and other applications to enhance operational capabilities and drive service excellence
* Represent Safety Technology Management in cross-functional collaboration with IT, Quality Assurance, and external auditors, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, security standards, and quality protocols
* Lead change management initiatives aligned with Software Development Life Cycle principles, including impact assessments, testing methodologies, system validation, and software updates
* Develop and deliver presentations and technical documentation for safety technology solutions, including authorship and review of standard operating procedures and controlled documents
* Lead issue resolution and collaboration with Parexel IT, vendors, Safety Services staff, and clients for proper analysis and closure of technical issues across supported systems
* Train, coach, and provide work directions to team members in system administration, database support, and strategic implementation activities
* Collaborate with Global Pharmacovigilance Intelligence Office to ensure safety systems maintain regulatory compliance and proactively meet evolving requirements

**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Advanced technical expertise in pharmacovigilance safety technology systems, including complex configurations, system administration, and application support
* Exceptional interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels
* Advanced analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a client-focused approach
* Strong leadership presence with the ability to mentor team members and represent the organization in cross-functional environments
* Demonstrated experience in system validation, change management, and regulatory compliance (21 CFR Part 11, EMA Annex 11, GAMP)
* Proficiency with standard scripting languages (SQL), Service Desk Tools, and project management methodologies
* Knowledge of emerging pharmacovigilance technologies, including AI, with a flexible attitude toward continuous learning and new challenges
* Deep understanding of pharmacovigilance roles, standards, practices, GVP, and GCP requirements

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience with safety supportive applications (Argus, Vault Safety, EDC, Safety ERP) across all functional areas and secondary tools
* 5+ years of experience working closely with safety operations teams to manage issues, gather requirements, and deliver technology solutions
* Advanced knowledge and practical application of computer system regulations and guidance (21 CFR Part 11, EMA Annex 11, GAMP)
* Demonstrated proficiency with standard scripting languages (SQL) and industry-standard Service Desk Tools
* Strong technical writing capability and proven ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to diverse audiences

**Preferred Qualifications**

* BA/BSc in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field; master's degree preferred
* 1+ years of direct mentorship, training, or peer oversight experience
* Demonstrated lead participation in system/process improvement initiatives and 1+ years of system validation design and execution

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
  
  
If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be perfect fit, send them the link to apply!
